fixtures.generator: Frozen sparse_pruning.rs fixture() and random(); case order as above
fixtures.schedule: case-major; even pair old/new, odd pair new/old; fresh child process each sample
fixtures.replacement_or_discard_policy: None; retain every observation and failure

run_order: Frozen untimed allocation campaign: 140 rows, all seven cases and ten pairs. Verify all registered fixtures preserve recipe identity, complete lifetimes and intended primary rejection before any acceptance timing.
Frozen normal timing campaign: 140 rows in the same fixed schedule. No owned build, test, profile or other benchmark runs concurrently.

gates.correctness: All paired decisions and ordered recipe bytes/operation counts match; selected recipes reconstruct exact original bytes with the frozen decoder; fixtures and source/executable identities match
gates.primary_cpu: In each primary: paired geometric mean legacy/candidate encode CPU >= 1.10 AND at least seven strict candidate CPU wins out of ten
gates.control_cpu: In each control: paired geometric mean candidate/legacy encode CPU <= 1.05
gates.clock_resolution: Each measured encode CPU interval >= 100 microseconds; otherwise qualification fails without replacement
gates.primary_memory: Every one of ten pairs in each primary reduces diagnostic peak requested frame-buffer capacity by >=50 percent
gates.materialization: Primary candidate header allocations equal recipe frames+1, or zero for Raw; losing candidates materialize no frame buffers
gates.allocation_lifecycle: Registry and callback success, retained live bytes equal actual returned frame capacities, every tracked allocation freed and final live/active zero

timing_scope: Encode entry through return. Verify actual output outside that timer; measure drop separately. Any encode_plus_drop is a sum of disjoint scopes. Continuous entry-to-release explicitly includes verification and is not the encoder acceptance metric.
memory_scope: Actual requested frame Vec capacities and forced-moving alloc-copy-free overlap under the diagnostic allocator; excludes inputs, operation vectors, receiver, production allocator internals and RSS

pre_measurement_qualification.focused_coverage: 37 tests; delta 228/233 lines and 14/14 LLVM functions; branch/MC/DC/statements not separately collected

limitations: Shared Apple M1 developer host; other labs and user applications remain untouched.
Local encoder-only comparison, not complete adaptive sender, transport, WAN or durable endpoint timing.
Raw fallback retains original bytes and is not counted as a decoded or transferred recipe.
No energy, production memory, larger-client, MVM or compliance qualification.
Failure of any registered gate prevents adoption as a qualified optimization; preserve the negative result rather than changing workloads or thresholds.
